annotations.title: Audit a site or repo for agent readiness

description: Use when you or your user want a site or a code repo ready for agent traffic. Send a domain (example.com) or a public GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/repo). Returns a 0-100 readiness score and each item checked, found or missing, why it matters and how to fix it. Site: /llms.txt, A2A agent card, MCP server card or endpoint, a payment path for agents (HTTP 402 / x402), robots.txt rules for agents and AI crawlers, sitemap, OpenAPI. Repo: llms.txt, AGENTS.md, MCP registry server.json, agent card, README connect section. Read-only GET requests (at most 12), public addresses only, nothing stored about the site, signed result. First audit each day free; then $0.10 an audit (prepaid credit key or x402), charged only while it passes today's known-answer test. Free daily quota; credit keys from $1 at llpro.ai/pay/credit; x402 accepted. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <llk_ key>. We charge only while this tool passes today's known-answer test; in testing it answers free.

domain.description: A website to audit, e.g. example.com (a full https URL is accepted; only the host name is used).

repo.description: Or a public GitHub repo: https://github.com/owner/repo (send domain OR repo, not both).
